info.name: Abnormal Security Client Audit Logs API
Gets a list of Audit Logs for Portal

params.name: filter
params.description: Value must be of the format `filter={FILTER KEY} gte YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ lte YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. A `{FILTER KEY}` must be specified, and currently the only key that are supported for `/auditlogs` is `timestamp`. At least 1 of `gte`/`lte` must be specified, with a datetime string following the `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ format`. We limit the results returned to the last 90 days and will default to that if no filter is supplied.

params.name: action
params.description: Filters audit logs based on the action(s) taken. Accepts >= 1 options in a space-delimited string. Example: `view_message_content`

params.name: category
params.description: Filters audit logs based on their category(ies).Accepts >= 1 options in a space-delimited string. Example: `abuse_mailbox threat_log`

params.name: status
params.description: Filters audit logs based on their status

params.name: sourceIp
params.description: Filters audit logs based on their source IP address

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of audit logs that are on each page. Each page of data will have at most pageSize audit logs.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: 1-indexed page number to get a particular page of audit logs.

items.docs: Gets a list of Audit Logs for Portal
